$description: Tier 2 · Semantic roles. Emitted as --* (no prefix): the shadcn/ui contract plus the sidebar contract. `$value` is light mode; `$extensions["unicron.modes"].dark` is dark mode. Apps add their own roles in an extension layer (see examples/app-extension.css), never here.

unicron.theme.$description: Extra entries for the Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` block. Radius steps are multiples of --radius.

support-foreground.$description: Support text: the lines that explain, under a title or beside a value (descriptions, an empty state's text). Emphasis Engine's text level 4, between primary text (level 5, --foreground) and secondary text (level 3, --muted-foreground), at least Lc 10 from each on every page surface coded, and 12 as drawn (scripts/contrast.mjs; apps check the drawn side). Strong enough for every fill as it is.

muted-foreground.$description: Secondary text, drawn small: labels, meta (when, how many), captions, overlines, placeholders, inactive tabs, keys. Emphasis Engine's text level 3, a level below primary text (level 5): APCA Lc 75 (Bronze, under 16px) on every page surface it reads on, in each mode, and at least Lc 20 under primary text on the same surface (scripts/contrast.mjs). Inside a fill, it's re-pointed at --muted-foreground-on-fill (@unicron/ui's styles).

muted-foreground-on-fill.$description: Secondary text on a fill (bg-muted, bg-accent, bg-secondary, a highlighted or selected item, a key): a shade stronger in light mode so it still reads Lc 75 there (Lc 77 on neutral.100). A fill re-points --muted-foreground at it for its own content, so components and apps keep writing text-muted-foreground. Dark mode needs no shift: neutral.250 clears every dark fill.

destructive.$description: Destructive text, and the tint behind destructive labels (bg-destructive/10, /20). Solved as a readable red: Lc 75 as text on the page, a card and a selected row; Lc 60 as a label on its own tint (scripts/contrast.mjs).

warning.$description: A warning fill under --warning-foreground: the label Lc 60 or more, and the fill Lc 30 or more against the page, the sidebar and a selected row, in each mode.

info.$description: An info fill under --info-foreground: white on blue.500 in both modes, Lc 72.

success.$description: Done, worked, complete. The fill: a dot, an orb, a bar. Lc 30 or more against the page, the sidebar, a card and a selected row. It carries no text; words in this role use --success-foreground.

success-foreground.$description: Success as text and icons: Lc 75 or more on the page, a card, the sidebar, a selected row and --success-surface. Unlike --warning-foreground, it is ink on a surface, not a label on the fill.

success-surface.$description: A quiet success wash behind a row, a card or a callout, under --success-foreground.

attention.$description: Waiting on the person: a question, an approval, a choice. Not --warning, which says something is wrong. The fill: a dot, an orb, a bar. Lc 30 or more against the page, the sidebar, a card and a selected row. It carries no text; words in this role use --attention-foreground.

attention-foreground.$description: Attention as text and icons: Lc 75 or more on the page, a card, the sidebar, a selected row and --attention-surface. Unlike --warning-foreground, it is ink on a surface, not a label on the fill.

attention-surface.$description: A quiet attention wash behind a row, a card or a callout, under --attention-foreground.

running.$description: Working now: an agent thinking or running a step, a job in progress. The fill: a dot, an orb, a bar. Lc 30 or more against the page, the sidebar, a card and a selected row. It carries no text; words in this role use --running-foreground.

running-foreground.$description: Running as text and icons: Lc 75 or more on the page, a card, the sidebar, a selected row and --running-surface. Unlike --warning-foreground, it is ink on a surface, not a label on the fill.

running-surface.$description: A quiet running wash behind a row, a card or a callout, under --running-foreground.

input.$description: Control borders (fields, selects, checkboxes, the off switch) and, at 30-80%, the dark field and switch fills. 3:1 on every surface it borders (WCAG 1.4.11), so a field can be found.

ring.$description: Focus ring. The primitives draw it at 50% (ring-ring/50, outline-ring/50), so the step is dark enough that the half-strength ring still clears APCA Lc 30 on every surface (scripts/contrast.mjs).

motion-fast.$description: Small state changes and entrances: a hover, a press, a dialog or menu appearing. 120ms, the floor below which a change reads as a jump. Tailwind's default transition duration (`transition`, `transition-colors`) is mapped to it.

motion-base.$description: Larger moves: a sheet sliding in, a toast entering or leaving.

motion-press.$description: A control going down under a press. Release runs on motion-fast.

motion-state.$description: A surface changing state: a sheet or a panel opening, a selection moving.

motion-move.$description: Travel across the screen. The longest a default motion runs.

motion-tick.$description: One step of a countdown ring, run linear so it tracks the clock.

motion-ease-enter.$description: Things arriving: fast out, gentle settle. The same curve as motion-ease.

motion-ease-exit.$description: Things leaving: they gather speed and go. Pair it with a shorter duration than the entrance.

motion-ease-move.$description: Travel and resize: a selection moving, a panel changing height.

motion-ease-emphasis.$description: A slight overshoot for a rare moment, such as a success. Never on a control used many times a minute.

motion-ease-pulse.$description: The curve of a pulse loop.

motion-spring-settle.$description: A thumb or a pill arriving at a new place. Use as a timing function with motion-spring-settle-duration.

motion-spring-firm.$description: A sheet or another large surface arriving, with no visible bounce. Use with motion-spring-firm-duration.

motion-stagger.$description: The delay between siblings that enter in turn.

motion-stagger-max.$description: Siblings after this many start together.

motion-press-depth-small.$description: Scale of a pressed icon-size control.

motion-spin.$description: One turn of a spinner or a working ring, so live states turn at one rate in every app. Tailwind's animate-spin runs on it.

motion-pulse.$description: One beat of a pulse or a breathing halo (needs-you, thinking). Tailwind's animate-pulse runs on it.

motion-ease.$description: The one curve: fast out, gentle settle. Tailwind's default transition curve and `ease-standard` are mapped to it.
